### Summary of Changes

1. **[`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts)**:
   - In [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L7-L35), included both `createdAt` and deprecated `placedAt`, as well as `amountCents` and deprecated `totalCents`.
   - In [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/src/core/events.ts#L51-L71), populated both the new fields and legacy fields from the order.

2. **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/test/app.test.ts)** & **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/orders-service/test/adapters.test.ts)**:
   - Updated event assertions to verify both legacy and new fields are present and accurate.
